name: Arjun Patel
bio: Arjun Patel is a Bengaluru-based productivity researcher who teaches teams how to protect deep work in a distracted world.

name: Raj Patel
bio: Raj Patel is an educator and learning scientist who has spent two decades helping students learn how to learn.

name: James Wright
bio: James Wright is a leadership coach and speaker who writes practical guides on setting and reaching meaningful goals.

name: James Adams
bio: James Adams writes fast-paced thrillers with a dark edge, set in the quiet hours when cities sleep.

name: Jessica Martin
bio: Jessica Martin writes heartfelt romances about second chances and the people who change our lives.

name: Laura Mitchell
bio: Laura Mitchell is a former aerospace engineer who now writes science-fiction thrillers grounded in real physics.

name: Daniel Reed
bio: Daniel Reed is a writer, minimalist, and productivity coach based in San Francisco. With a passion for intentional living, Daniel has dedicated his career to helping individuals simplify their lives — one habit, one space, and one thought at a time.

He is the author of The Joy of Minimalism, an acclaimed guide to decluttering both physically and mentally. His other works include Less, But Better and The Focus Reset, which have helped thousands rethink consumerism, prioritize what truly matters, and build sustainable systems for personal growth.

name: Clara Nelson
bio: Clara Nelson writes atmospheric mysteries about old houses and the secrets families keep.

name: Emilly Parker
bio: Emilly Parker writes and illustrates warm, gentle stories for young readers and their families.

name: Ananya Rao
bio: Ananya Rao is a Kochi-born novelist whose love stories are steeped in rain, letters and longing.

name: Vikram Sen
bio: Vikram Sen is a former crime reporter from Kolkata who now writes tightly plotted courtroom mysteries.

name: Mira Kapoor
bio: Mira Kapoor writes epic young-adult fantasy inspired by Indian mythology and folklore.

name: Neha Kulkarni
bio: Neha Kulkarni is a historian and novelist who brings the final decades of the Raj to vivid life.

name: Rohan Mehta
bio: Rohan Mehta is a biographer and architecture critic based in Mumbai.

name: Kavya Iyer
bio: Kavya Iyer is a food writer whose memoirs mix family history with recipes from her grandmother’s kitchen.

name: Sameer Khan
bio: Sameer Khan is a travel writer and photographer who has crossed the Himalaya on foot, by bike and by bus.

name: Priya Nair
bio: Priya Nair is a home cook and food blogger who makes regional Indian cooking approachable for everyone.

name: Aditya Joshi
bio: Aditya Joshi is a comic artist and writer creating superhero stories for a new generation of Indian readers.

name: Meera Das
bio: Meera Das is a poet whose verses trace rivers, memory and the quiet music of everyday life.

name: Dr. Arvind Bose
bio: Dr. Arvind Bose is an astrophysicist and science communicator who makes the universe feel close to home.

name: Sara Thomas
bio: Sara Thomas teaches philosophy and writes about the big questions that shape how we live.

name: Rahul Verma
bio: Rahul Verma is a language teacher who has helped thousands of learners speak Hindi with confidence.

name: Munshi Premchand
bio: Munshi Premchand (1880–1936) was one of the most celebrated writers of Hindi and Urdu literature, known for his realistic portrayals of rural Indian life.

name: Harivansh Rai Bachchan
bio: Harivansh Rai Bachchan (1907–2003) was a renowned Hindi poet of the Chhayavad literary movement.
